purpose: Reject expired same-key pending-order replay without redesigning idempotency storage.
success_outcome: Backend and real-browser evidence return sanitized 409 with zero replacement order/reservation after controlled expiry.
anti_goals: No new idempotency ledger, database, service, or architecture.
No change to valid in-window replay, expiry-job ownership, FT-008 Admin, or FT-009 provider behavior.
No Medusa Core change, production data, secret, or direct browser database access.

forbidden_scope: FT-009 payment-provider calls, webhook, or credentials
production data, secrets, direct browser database access

success_checks: Expired replay leaves order/reservation counts unchanged.
In-window same-key replay still returns the original order.
Browser removes stale success and renders only sanitized conflict.
T3 markers and semantic-pass evidence are recorded.
evidence_required: Current-source gates, privacy/cleanup scans, and full T3 markers.

stop_conditions: Fix requires a new ledger or public contract change.
Valid in-window replay or expiry cleanup semantics regress.
Zero mutation after expired replay cannot be proved.
Cleanup or privacy is not reproducible.
